summary: Iteration 6 — backend-only review of Service Provider Availability + Profile-Image features. All 18 new pytest cases PASS (18/18, 100%). Verified: (1) POST /api/users/me/profile-image accepts a valid base64 data URI and persists profile_image on the user doc; rejects empty / non-image payloads with 400; rejects >1.5 MB payload with 413. (2) DELETE clears the field. (3) GET /api/auth/me echoes profile_image. (4) PATCH /api/services/me/availability returns 403 for non-providers, 400 for invalid status, 200 + persists for available/busy/offline. (5) GET /api/services DEFAULT correctly hides offline providers while keeping available/busy/no-status visible; explicit availability=available|busy|offline filters return only the requested bucket. (6) GET /api/services/{id}/profile surfaces both availability_status and profile_image; 404 path verified. (7) GET /api/admin/service-analytics availability buckets (available+busy+offline+unset) SUM EXACTLY to total providers (is_service_provider=true) in Mongo. No critical or minor backend issues found in scope.

Pre-existing test files (test_backend_api.py, test_iteration2/3/4.py) repeatedly hit 429 when run together — they also still reference the deleted admin@app.com / Admin@123 credentials (replaced 2026-05-29 by support@networkrupay.com). [LOW] Legacy test suites (test_backend_api.py, test_iteration2/3.py) still use old admin@app.com credentials and have no 429 backoff — consider porting them to ADMIN_EMAIL from .env and adding the same retry pattern used in test_iteration6_provider.py to keep regressions green.

[LOW] /api/services list endpoint capped at 500 results in the geo path; the non-geo path has no explicit cap (regular find().to_list(...)). If provider count grows, add a default page/limit so the listing stays bounded — out of scope for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1916 — POST /users/me/profile-image correctly validates `startswith('data:image/')` so `data:text/plain;...` is rejected. Good.

server.py:7849-7856 — list_services correctly defaults to {availability_status: {$ne: 'offline'}} when no explicit filter is provided. Critical correctness: providers with NO availability_status field also stay visible because `$ne: 'offline'` matches missing fields in Mongo. Verified empirically — the unset bucket in admin analytics is non-zero and those providers DO appear in the default listing.

service_provider.py:41-45 — PATCH /services/me/availability gates on `user.get('is_service_provider')` (truthy check) and normalises status to lower().strip(). Both 400 and 403 paths produce clean JSON errors. No issues.
service_admin.py:151-156 — admin_service_analytics avail bucket falls back unknown values into 'unset', so the sum-to-total invariant always holds. Verified.
core/utils.py:16 — serialize_user simply pops _id and password_hash, so profile_image and availability_status pass through to /auth/me unfiltered. Good.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_provider.py (new — 18 cases across 5 test classes, with 429 backoff and Mongo teardown)

verified_features.profile_image_upload: Small base64 jpeg accepted; profile_image_updated_at stamped; doc persisted in users collection.
verified_features.profile_image_validation: Empty string → 400; data:text/plain → 400; >1.5MB base64 → 413 (verified at length 2_133_356 chars).
verified_features.profile_image_delete: DELETE unsets both profile_image and profile_image_updated_at; /auth/me no longer surfaces it.
verified_features.auth_me_includes_profile_image: Bearer-auth /auth/me returns profile_image field exactly as stored.
verified_features.availability_patch_403: Non-provider PATCH /services/me/availability → 403 'Only service providers can set availability'.
verified_features.availability_patch_400: Invalid status 'vacationing' → 400 'status must be one of: available, busy, offline'.
verified_features.availability_patch_200: All three valid statuses persist users.availability_status + users.availability_updated_at and return {ok:true, availability_status, availability_updated_at}.
verified_features.services_default_hides_offline: Seeded 3 providers (available/busy/offline). Default GET /api/services includes available + busy IDs, EXCLUDES offline. Verified.
verified_features.services_explicit_filters: availability=offline → only offline IDs; busy → only busy; available → only available. Every returned row has matching availability_status field. Verified.
verified_features.provider_profile_detail: GET /api/services/{id}/profile returns availability_status and profile_image fields. 404 returned for random UUID.
verified_features.admin_availability_buckets_sum: Sum of avail buckets (available+busy+offline+unset) == db.users.count_documents({is_service_provider:true}). Invariant holds.
